snippet.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered | The Tarnished Mirror Reveal Trailer and Physical Announcement
snippet.description:
Digital and physical pre-orders are now available for Thief: The Dark Project Remastered on PS5 and Switch consoles with your choice of Standard, Steelbook, and Trapezoid Editions.

In addition to a Standard Digital Edition ($29.99), a Deluxe Digital Edition ($34.99) is available on PC and consoles that includes an art book, the official soundtrack and an excerpt of an upcoming novelization of   Thief: The Dark Project. Physical Editions of the remaster for PlayStation 5 and the Nintendo Switch 2 are now available for pre-order here. The Steelbook Edition ($39.99) includes the standard game, Steelbook and a printed manual. The Deluxe Trapezoid Edition ($69.99) includes the standard game, printed manual, Steelbook, and a Remaster Diary in a recreation of the trapezoid-shaped “big-box” retail packaging of the original 1998 release. The Standard Physical Edition is $29.99. All physical versions for the Nintendo Switch 2 are playable on the original Nintendo Switch.

Thief: The Dark Project Remastered will launch on December 3 for PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX Play Anywhere, Nintendo Switch 2, PC via Steam, Epic Games Store and GOG, in addition to PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch. Nintendo Switch owners can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition for free.

For more details on Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, visit https://atari.com/products/thief-the-dark-project-remastered
